authority: Planner ruling after D0 v1 (evidence commit a781024a; postcheck_v1 unit_failure_diagnosis): D0 v2 -- shared ESS enters the TN-only model only as a fixed injection; a diagnostic configuration choice, not a production change
TASKS.md S56 order, step H (D0 v2)
blocks: 20 TSO (year, day) blocks per cell: years 2025/2028/2031/2034/2037 x Spring/Summer/Autumn/Winter; 9 joint scenarios (3 market x 3 operation) each
cells_root: data/SRP1/Results/P515S53/w90_3x3/campaign_s53_w91_3x3_pair/evals (campaign spec campaign_spec_s53_w91_3x3_pair_231558f0.json); inputs multiscenario_terminal.json, evaluation_record.json, component_levels_terminal.json, each sha256-checked against child_manifest_sha256.json

change_from_v1.day_balance_slacks: slack_shared_es_soc_final_up/down then appear in no active row; they stay in the objective at the production weight, bounded [0, ub]; reported separately (not in C, not in the P5 grid set)
change_from_v1.everything_else: identical to v1: production build, candidate application, ADN setup, objective, solver and options, extraction, statistics formulas (v1 functions imported, v1 files unedited)
change_from_v1.not_rechecked: the ESS own feasibility (SoC, capability, closure) is not re-checked here; it belongs to the ESSO
change_from_v1.success_test: v1 read a failed solve as loaded (result is not None); v2 applies production helper_functions.solver_result_succeeded inside the run and extracts nothing from a rejected solve
change_from_v1.what: In the TN-only model of both arms of both cells, the shared ESS enters only as a FIXED INJECTION: the scenario-free alias copies shared_es_pnet/qnet[e, s_m0, s_o0, p] (mch.sess_na_scenario; the only shared-ESS variables in node_balance_p/q, via mch.compute_node_load) are fixed at the saved TSO terminal schedule (as v1), and EVERY shared-ESS internal row of the TSO block is deactivated for every shared ESS: production list mch._SHARED_ESS_OPERATIONAL_CONSTRAINTS (model.shared_ess_rows_deactivated). If the fixed injection lies outside its own variable bounds, that bound alone is relaxed (recorded per block; none expected: pnet/qnet are unbounded at positive capacity, [0, 0] at zero capacity with a zero schedule).
change_from_v1.why: v1 kept the internal rows active with pnet/qnet fixed; the TSO terminal schedule violates its own rows by ~1e-8 p.u. (SoC limits) and up to 1.0008 (capability ratio), leaving no interior: 11/40 unit solves failed (postcheck_v1 unit_failure_diagnosis).
change_from_v1.x0: every shared ESS has zero capacity in x0; production configure_shared_ess_operational_state already deactivated its rows and fixed its variables at 0, so the change is inert there (P2)

failure_policy: no re-run, no tuning, no other settings; a failed solve is recorded (its block excluded from D1 and reported); a pre-solve gate failure refuses the run with zero solves

guards.SolveProfileGuard: permitted call site p515_s56_tn_realized_resolve_v2.py:_solve_one, installed before any project import; exactly 80 solves and 80 executions (2 cells x 2 arms x 20 blocks); 0 under --trial or a pre-solve refusal; the guards the imported v1 and post-check modules install at import are uninstalled right after import (LIFO, v2 guard restored, asserted by identity), counts recorded, all must be 0
guards.lock: single instance (.tn_realized_resolve.lock beside the output, as v1); refuses if .p515_s44_campaign.lock exists or a campaign harness / concurrency gate / D0 v1, v2, post-check / V0 process runs
guards.pickle: pickle.load/loads blocked for the whole run (no pickle is read), verified 0
guards.run: attached, alone, stdout and stderr captured to sibling logs run_v2_stdout.log / run_v2_stderr.log

imports: p515_s56_tn_realized_resolve.py (v1: load_cell, block_data, build_arm, model_gates, extract, max_violation, configure)

model.absent: no ADMM augmented-Lagrangian or proximal terms, no interface-voltage pin, no row 18 (the TSO never carries it), no expected-value Vars, no consensus voltage target: the TN interface voltage is free within its bounds in both arms
model.adn_setup: as create_transmission_network_model: slack_v_sqr_down/up at the ADN bus fixed 0 (when voltage slacks are on); pc/qc bounds removed and the value fixed; ADN flexibility legs fixed 0; interface_delta_p/q fixed 0 in every scenario
model.arm_A: control: ADN pc/qc fixed in every scenario at the TSO terminal scenario-common exchange (interface_profiles.per_scenario, TSO side = pc + interface_delta; asserted scenario-common to 1e-9 MW)
model.arm_B: ADN pc/qc fixed per scenario at the DN realized pg_adn/qg_adn of that scenario (DSO block interface_profiles.per_scenario, key <s_m>_<s_o>, the formulation pairing); everything else as A
model.build: production NetworkData.build_model() of the TN (deep copy of the instance per cell); candidate applied as production: update_data_with_candidate_solution(total_capacity), update_model_with_candidate_solution(total_capacity), then update_model_with_candidate_solution(terminal published available capacity per node and year, evaluation_record storage_per_node.published_available_capacity_terminal -- the value the TSO block carried at the terminal cycle); production _prepare_transmission_objectives_for_admm (penalty_shared_ess_usage 0, penalty_gen_curtailment 0, cost_load_curtailment ADMM value); interface_settlement_weight then set to 0
model.isolation_gate: per block: no sess row active; the only active rows referencing any shared_es_*/slack_shared_es_* variable are node_balance_p/q, through FIXED pnet/qnet at (e, s_m0, s_o0, p); the only shared-ESS variables with a nonzero objective coefficient are the day-balance slacks; any gate failure refuses the run with zero solves
model.no_code_change_basis: the TN node balance (mch compute_node_load) and interface expression read pc[c, s_m, s_o, p] per scenario (verified: mch interface_pf_p_transmission_def, compute_node_load; srp create_transmission_network_model fixes the same Var per scenario)
model.shared_ess: pnet/qnet of the scenario-free copy (sess_na_scenario) fixed at the TSO block terminal shared_ess_schedule in both arms, as v1; every shared-ESS internal row deactivated (v2)

objective.reported_C: C = total_gen_cost + total_flex_cost: TN generation (controllable units at the scenario market price) + TN flexibility, EUR per representative day, probability-weighted over the 9 scenarios; gross, settlement-EXCLUDED, no salvage; the full objective and the slack/detector terms reported beside
objective.solved: production objective_function_rule = total_gen_cost + total_flex_cost + total_load_curt_cost + total_gen_curt_penalty (weight 0) + total_ess_utilization_cost_penalty (shared weight 0) + total_slack_penalties + total_ess_complementarity_penalties (shared-ESS day-balance slack) + 0 x interface_settlement; checked equal to model.objective and to the sum of parts at the built point

predictions.P1: 80/80 solves "Optimal Solution Found." (termination optimal, production success test true, IPOPT exit "Optimal Solution Found."; "Solved To Acceptable Level" counts as a failure)
predictions.P2: x0 (no storage installed, the change is inert) reproduces v1 x0 C_A and C_B per block to <= 1e-9 relative: for each of the 20 blocks and both arms |C_v2 - C_v1| / max(|C_v2|, |C_v1|, 1) <= 1e-9, C = total_gen_cost + total_flex_cost per representative day; all 40 must hold
predictions.P3: unit D1 weighted (sum_b w_b D1_b, full 20-block horizon) between 0.5 and 1.0 MEUR, read signed: 500,000 <= D1_w(unit) <= 1,000,000 EUR; indeterminate if the unit cell is incomplete
predictions.P4: |D1(x0) - D1(unit)| < 18 kEUR on the full 20-block horizon (low confidence); indeterminate if either cell is incomplete
predictions.P5: Arm B TN slacks <= 0 within IPOPT bound relaxation on every block of both cells, including unit 2028 Spring: read as every Arm B block loaded by production and the max value of every TN grid slack Var (slack_v_sqr_up/down, slack_node_balance_p/q_up/down, slack_flow_ij/ji_sqr, slack_flex_p_balance_up/down, those present) <= 1e-8 p.u. (IPOPT bound_relax_factor default 1e-8 x max(1, |lb|) at a zero lower bound; not overridden in the options in force); the shared-ESS day-balance slacks (detached from any row in v2) reported separately
predictions.recorded_by: Planner, before the run (D0 v2 task)

solver.call: Network.run_smopf(model, params, from_warm_start=False), from the model own initial values
solver.inherited_unchanged: every other TN case-file option (as the central check, spec 0e00f6a8)
solver.success_test: production helper_functions.solver_result_succeeded(result) on the result Network.run_smopf returns (solver status ok and termination optimal/locallyOptimal/globallyOptimal; production loads the solution exactly then, and returns None if loading fails); nothing extracted from a rejected solve; strict = accepted and IPOPT exit "Optimal Solution Found."

stage: P5.15 S56 D0 v2 TN realized-exchange re-solve, shared ESS as a fixed injection (frozen spec v2)

statistics.D1_b: (C_B,b - C_A,b) - cov_b; D1 = sum_b w_b D1_b per cell

auxiliary.V_b: sum_DN sum_s omega_s sum_t pi[s_m,t] (P_DSO[s,t] - P_TSO[t]) = cov_b + the priced consensus residual; D1prime_b = (C_B - C_A) - V_b
auxiliary.first_order: sum dual_A(node_balance_p/q at the ADN bus) x (Arm B - Arm A) interface P/Q (p.u.): first-order prediction of C_B - C_A from Arm A duals
auxiliary.mc: per-scenario TN marginal cost at the ADN bus = dual(node_balance_p[i, s_m, s_o, t]) / (omega_s x baseMVA) EUR/MWh (Pyomo/IPOPT sign: dual = d obj / d load, verified on a toy model)
auxiliary.sanity: C_A vs the saved TN generation cost of the cell (component_levels_terminal generation_cost) and objective A vs block_recourse_production_local: reported, not gated; the ADMM block carried the augmented/proximal terms, the voltage pin and the consensus voltage target, absent here

statistics.cov_b: sum over DN of the DSO block covariance settlement (settlement deviation, unweighted), recomputed from per-scenario pg_adn and the DSO block price array and checked (abs <= 1e-6 max(1,|x|)); sum_b w_b cov_b checked against the summary dso_deviation_part (x0: -748,745.77 EUR)
statistics.pair: D1(x0) - D1(unit) on the full 20-block horizon (only when both cells are complete) and on the 12 blocks common to v1 (v1_common_blocks, postcheck_v1 pair_v2.valid; 58.7 % of weight; v1 pair 19.01 EUR)
statistics.resolution: reported beside: each cell certification bar (evaluation_record bar: x0 13,954.38 EUR, unit 4,010.57 EUR); the D1 inputs C_A, C_B are IPOPT re-solves at tol 1e-5, cov_b is the ADMM terminal value
statistics.storage_tn_side: per block C_A(unit) - C_A(x0), C_B(unit) - C_B(x0) (each cell at its own fixed exchange; the exchanges differ between cells too) and the fixed node-7 schedule (charge/discharge/net MWh, capability ratio)
statistics.unit_vs_x0: per block D1(unit) - D1(x0), dC, cov of each cell, and the post-check attribution by class
statistics.validity: a block enters D1 only when both arms pass the production success test; strict variant: both arms "Optimal Solution Found."; coverage as the share of sum_b w_b
statistics.weighting: weighted = sum_b w_b x_b, w_b = production _get_admm_block_weight(TN, year, day) = years x days x 1.02^-(y-2025) (the Q weighting; checked equal to the saved admm_block_weight); x_b unweighted per representative day, probability-weighted over scenarios
